item.title: Epic says "Fortnite is coming back to the App Store in Australia tomorrow" after an Australian federal judge ordered Apple to open up iOS in an antitrust case (Rhea Rose Abraham/Reuters)
item.description:
Rhea Rose Abraham / Reuters:
Epic says “Fortnite is coming back to the App Store in Australia tomorrow” after an Australian federal judge ordered Apple to open up iOS in an antitrust case  —  Epic Games said its shooter title “Fortnite” will return to Apple's (AAPL.O) App Store in Australia on Thursday …

Original (direct link): https://www.reuters.com/technology/epic-games-fortnite-returns-apple-app-store-australia-2026-10-22/

item.title: An Australian federal judge rules Apple must let Australian iPhone users install apps from third-party app stores starting March 1, 2027; Apple plans to appeal (Marcus Mendes/9to5Mac)
item.description:
Marcus Mendes / 9to5Mac:
An Australian federal judge rules Apple must let Australian iPhone users install apps from third-party app stores starting March 1, 2027; Apple plans to appeal  —  An Australian federal judge has ordered Apple to make sweeping changes to its App Store rules following a years-long antitrust battle with Epic Games.

Original (direct link): https://9to5mac.com/2026/10/21/apple-must-open-iphone-to-alternative-app-stores-in-australia-after-epic-games-ruling/

item.title: Walmart unveils its Agent Gateway, a new MCP server to help users' approved AI agents shop its website, and dedicated Agent Profiles with special "terms" for AI (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
item.description:
Sarah Perez / TechCrunch:
Walmart unveils its Agent Gateway, a new MCP server to help users' approved AI agents shop its website, and dedicated Agent Profiles with special “terms” for AI  —  Walmart is embracing agentic commerce with the launch of its own Agent Gateway to manage transactions …

Original (direct link): https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/21/while-amazon-blocks-ai-agents-walmart-rolls-out-the-welcome-mat/

item.title: Sources: DeepSeek raised ~$15B in its latest fundraising round, one of China's largest ever, with CATL and Tencent among the biggest contributors (Lulu Yilun Chen/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Lulu Yilun Chen / Bloomberg:
Sources: DeepSeek raised ~$15B in its latest fundraising round, one of China's largest ever, with CATL and Tencent among the biggest contributors  —  The Chinese AI pioneer DeepSeek has raised about 100 billion yuan ($15 billion) in its latest fundraising round, one of the country's largest ever …

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-22/deepseek-raises-15-billion-in-challenge-to-leading-us-labs

item.title: AWS analysts claim that at least one actor started to exploit the PHP2Shell bugs on October 17, four days prior to the vulnerabilities' public disclosure (Lily Hay Newman/Wired)
item.description:
Lily Hay Newman / Wired:
AWS analysts claim that at least one actor started to exploit the PHP2Shell bugs on October 17, four days prior to the vulnerabilities' public disclosure  —  Amazon Web Services logged attempts to leverage the internet-melting PHP2Shell bugs four days ago.  They're now being “broadly exploited” across the internet.

Original (direct link): https://www.wired.com/story/hackers-exploited-the-php-vulnerabilities-days-before-they-were-patched/

item.title: GM says it plans to debut OnStar AI, an in-car assistant that can execute vehicle functions and run diagnostics via voice commands, in the 2027 Cadillac Lyriq (Aarian Marshall/Wired)
item.description:
Aarian Marshall / Wired:
GM says it plans to debut OnStar AI, an in-car assistant that can execute vehicle functions and run diagnostics via voice commands, in the 2027 Cadillac Lyriq  —  The Detroit automaker wants your next vehicle to be a personal assistant, a best friend, and an autonomous errand-runner.

Original (direct link): https://www.wired.com/story/gm-wants-your-car-to-do-your-chores/

item.title: Sources: advisers within Elon Musk's empire are pushing to announce a SpaceX-Tesla merger by H1 2027 so it can close while President Trump remains in power (Bloomberg)
item.description:
Bloomberg:
Sources: advisers within Elon Musk's empire are pushing to announce a SpaceX-Tesla merger by H1 2027 so it can close while President Trump remains in power  —  Time is running out to pull off the $3.7 trillion merger before political and financial environments take a turn.

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/features/2026-10-22/tesla-spacex-merger-why-musk-wants-a-deal-before-trump-leaves-office

item.title: Cloud provider Railway says an unauthorized party may have accessed customer encrypted environment variables and, for some, obtained the decrypted contents (Jacob Cooper/Railway Blog)
item.description:
Jacob Cooper / Railway Blog:
Cloud provider Railway says an unauthorized party may have accessed customer encrypted environment variables and, for some, obtained the decrypted contents  —  Earlier this morning, Railway detected anomalous activity involving systems that store customer environment variables.

Original (direct link): https://blog.railway.com/p/security-disclosure-wednesday-october-21st

item.title: AuxoAI, which helps large businesses build and deploy AI systems, raised a $20.7M Series A led by NTTVC to accelerate growth and scale (Kyt Dotson/SiliconANGLE)
item.description:
Kyt Dotson / SiliconANGLE:
AuxoAI, which helps large businesses build and deploy AI systems, raised a $20.7M Series A led by NTTVC to accelerate growth and scale  —  AuxoAI Inc., an enterprise engineering and consulting company that helps large businesses build and deploy artificial intelligence systems …

Original (direct link): https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/20/auxoai-raises-over-20m-to-bring-ai-expertise-to-the-enterprise-and-redesign-how-work-gets-done/

item.title: SAP: Q3 cloud revenue up 25% YoY to €6.67B, vs. €6.57B est., total revenue up 12% to €10.27B, current cloud backlog up 26% to €24.1B, all in constant currencies (Christina Kyriasoglou/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Christina Kyriasoglou / Bloomberg:
SAP: Q3 cloud revenue up 25% YoY to €6.67B, vs. €6.57B est., total revenue up 12% to €10.27B, current cloud backlog up 26% to €24.1B, all in constant currencies  —  SAP SE reported higher growth for its cloud products than anticipated in a sign that the boom …

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-21/sap-cloud-growth-beats-forecast-in-sign-of-software-s-resilience

item.title: IBM reports Q3 revenue up 5% YoY to $17.1B, above $16.82B est., net income up 26% to $2.19B, software revenue up 8% to $7.8B, and infrastructure revenue up 4% (Elias Schisgall/Wall Street Journal)
item.description:
Elias Schisgall / Wall Street Journal:
IBM reports Q3 revenue up 5% YoY to $17.1B, above $16.82B est., net income up 26% to $2.19B, software revenue up 8% to $7.8B, and infrastructure revenue up 4%  —  The company reported a third-quarter profit of $2.19 billion, up from $1.74 billion a year earlier

Original (direct link): https://www.wsj.com/business/earnings/ibm-reports-higher-profit-as-some-slipped-deals-come-through-c0bb0640

item.title: GitLab patches a critical flaw that lets unauthenticated attackers run code on self-managed servers, affecting every release since 7.0 in 2014 (Swati Khandelwal/The Hacker News)
item.description:
Swati Khandelwal / The Hacker News:
GitLab patches a critical flaw that lets unauthenticated attackers run code on self-managed servers, affecting every release since 7.0 in 2014  —  GitLab released fixes on October 21 for a flaw that lets an attacker run code on a self-managed server without logging in, and it affects every version …

Original (direct link): https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/critical-gitlab-flaw-cvss-100-could.html

item.title: Texas Instruments reports Q3 revenue up 28% YoY to $6.06B, above $5.93B est., net income up 78% YoY to $2.43B, and forecasts $5.8B-$6.3B in Q4, vs. $5.73B est. (Ian King/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Ian King / Bloomberg:
Texas Instruments reports Q3 revenue up 28% YoY to $6.06B, above $5.93B est., net income up 78% YoY to $2.43B, and forecasts $5.8B-$6.3B in Q4, vs. $5.73B est.  —  Texas Instruments Inc., the biggest maker of analog and embedded processing chips, gave a strong revenue forecast for the current period …

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-21/texas-instruments-forecast-tops-estimates-after-demand-picks-up

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg says Muse has drawn 10M+ users since its launch and 25%+ of users are making purchases through the app, with an average purchase size of $200+ (Business Insider)
item.description:
Business Insider:
Mark Zuckerberg says Muse has drawn 10M+ users since its launch and 25%+ of users are making purchases through the app, with an average purchase size of $200+  —  - Meta reported third-quarter earnings on Wednesday.  — Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said over 10 million people have set up a Muse AI agent since its launch.

Original (direct link): https://www.businessinsider.com/meta-q3-2026-earnings-mark-zuckerberg-muse-ai-app-users-2026-10
